'''Roland's Doom''' is a mine located in southeastern [[Duskwood]], due east of the [[Rotting Orchard]]. It is here that the [[Night elf|night elven]] [[Priestess of the Moon|priestess]] [[Velinde Starsong]], the former wielder of the [[Scythe of Elune]], disappeared. Interacting with the [[Mound of Dirt (Duskwood)|mound of dirt]] there can invoke an echo of her.<ref>{{Alliance}} [30] [[The Scythe of Elune (quest)]]</ref><ref>{{Alliance}} [30] [[Answered Questions]]</ref> One day, [[Jitters]] found the Scythe, summoning more [[worgen]] and in time the [[Dark Riders]] upon [[Duskwood]] and [[Darkshire]], condemning them to permanent darkness. The mine is now the location of [[Gutspill]] and [[Nefaru]], who lead the worgen at the [[Rotting Orchard]].
